column1: # renames.tsv -- old name -> new name for the 2026-10-05 rename of every
# function and global.  Older commits, the Ghidra project and history notes
# use the old names; this table maps them.  The linker keeps 8 characters,
# so a symbol file shows "_" + the first 7 characters of the new name.
